name: Maribel Quince
description: Ambitious, controlled, and publicly devoted to the Tideglass Quay opening. A scandal could ruin her career, which makes her both helpful and guarded.

name: Jonah Pike
description: A salt-stiffened veteran of underwater salvage who speaks in omens but notices practical details others miss. His old quarrels with harbor engineers make him an easy suspect.

name: Celia Venn
description: Sharp, wounded, and more informed than she first admits. She argued with Alaric over a sealed family ledger shortly before he disappeared.

name: Tomas Reed
description: A charming sketch artist assigned to capture the unveiling for the morning edition. He arrived early, drew constantly, and claims his drawings prove he saw nothing unusual.

name: Edda Krail
description: Keeper of the condemned chapel’s keys and habits. She resents the city’s neglect of the tower and insists no living hand could have entered it without her knowing.
